newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves up in April.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves up in April.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose $23 million in the second half of April to $6,373 million, according to central bank figures published on Saturday.
Gross reserves had risen by $29.19 million in the first half of April to $6,350 million.
Gross reserves include commercial banks' net foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.
The balance sheet did not give the bank's net reserves which stood at $4,310 million at the end of March and at $4,015 million at the end of 1996 compared with $2,858 million a year ealier.
